identification: Box of about 11 books, mostly Ion L. Idriess. Named spines: two modern Idriess Greatest Stories omnibus volumes; Forty Fathoms Deep (A&R orange cloth, no jacket); Forty Fathoms Deep (Discovery Press modern leatherette reprint); Flynn of the Inland (A&R brown cloth, no jacket, spine sticker); Nemarluk (A&R cloth, no jacket); The Cattle King (A&R, seventh edition, jacket chipped); Lightning Ridge (paperback reprint); Roaming Round New Zealand by Frank Clune (jacket torn); one green cloth title unreadable. No title pages seen so first printings unconfirmed. Idriess firsts in jacket can be hundreds (Flynn 1932 collectors' guide $1,000+ in VG jacket), but jacketless A&R cloth copies, reprints and a 7th edition Cattle King are worth little each. Box looks like roughly $60 to $150 resale in total unless Flynn or Nemarluk or the green book proves a first.

viewing_check: Open the title pages of Flynn of the Inland (1932 first vs later edition; look for edition statement on the back of the title page), Nemarluk (1941 first), and both Forty Fathoms Deep A&R copies (1936 first). Identify the green-grey cloth book with blue spine print. Check the dust jackets on Cattle King and Clune and look for library marks or inscriptions. Only a true first Flynn or an inscribed copy changes the value.
